text:
ashley: Quick note — playground invoke helper + run history UX: saw a few annoyances when function schemas are long.
jamal: tell us.
ashley: On narrow screens helper overlays history and there's no focus trap or screen reader announcement. Also header 'Args' reads terse.
elaine: Recommend 'Function inputs (schema)'. clearer.
mike: Copy button labelling: it says 'Copy' but copies compact JSON. Change to 'Copy JSON' and add 'Copy pretty' option. Also show a small toast 'Copied JSON (pretty)'.
ashley: Also propose a micro-preview in run history showing up to 3 top keys (title · id · status) to make scanning faster. Clicking any key opens helper at that field.
jamal: Hide internal keys starting with '_' by default; add 'show hidden fields' toggle. Announce counts (e.g., 'Showing 3 of 7 fields').
elaine: For long descriptions clamp to 2 lines and add 'Show more' with aria-expanded.
mike: UI nit: beta badge contrast fails 3:1 — file a fix.
ashley: I'll mock the micro-preview + pretty copy toggle and post before the 2pm UX sync. :thumbsup:
